name: Gakuen Senshi Sailor Fighter
original_name: 学園戦士セーラーファイター
source:
Minako was just an ordinary Japanese teenage girl - until she was killed by an evil gym teacher, whom she dared to oppose. However, she was resurrected with the help of cyborg technology, operated by a mysterious creature with a normal Japanese surname Yoda - and yes, he looks just like the famous character from Star Wars. Yoda explains to Minako that her school has been possessed by demons, one of which is her former gym teacher, now turned principal! Minako heads back to her school, determined to demonstrate her new skills to the forces of evil!

Looks like all those cybernetic enhancements served just one purpose: enrich Minako's knowledge of contemporary Japanese pop culture. Because the only gameplay in this game involves answering timed trivia questions. The moment Minako encounters an opponent, the screen displays a fake battle field, and the quiz begins. If the player answers correctly, Minako causes damage to her opponent; if the answer is wrong, Minako sustains damage herself. Too many wrong answers result in Minako's death, this time irrevocable.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/47737/gakuen-senshi-sailor-fighter/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
美奈子只是一个普通的日本少女，直到她被邪恶的体育老师杀死，她敢于反抗。然而，她在半机械人技术的帮助下复活了，由一个有着正常日本姓氏尤达的神秘生物操作——是的，他看起来就像《星球大战》中的著名角色。尤达向美奈子解释说，她的学校已经被恶魔附身，其中之一就是她以前的体育老师，现在成了校长！美奈子回到学校，决心向邪恶势力展示她的新技能！

看起来所有这些控制论增强功能都只有一个目的：丰富美奈子对当代日本流行文化的了解。因为这个游戏的唯一玩法就是回答定时问答题。美奈子遇到对手的那一刻，屏幕上出现了一个假战场，问答开始了。如果玩家回答正确，美奈子会对对手造成伤害；如果答案错误，美奈子自己也会受到伤害。太多错误的答案导致美奈子的死亡，这一次是不可挽回的。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/47737/gakuen-senshi-sailor-fighter/]MobyGames[/url]]
